messages:
maya: Quick check — found 2 dead anchors in /docs/runtime/serving.md (section ids changed). I opened a tiny PR to fix and update shortlinks. Ping for a quick review when free. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

olivia: Thanks maya. Can you paste the failing link examples? want to confirm redirects won't break other pages.

maya: Sure — failing anchors: `#kv-cache-behavior` and `#batching-configs`. In the PR I replace with `#kv-cache` and `#batching-policy` respectively. Diff snippet:
```diff
- /docs/runtime/serving.md#kv-cache-behavior
+ /docs/runtime/serving.md#kv-cache
```

ryan: I'll take a quick look. heads-up: CI might flake on the mdx linter; if it's just anchors should be fine. @simon can you do a conventional-commits check?

simon: On it, will review in ~30m. If CI complains we can push a targeted fix in a separate commit. :+1:

lisa: I ran the site-link-checker locally — found 3 more weak anchors under /docs/guide/ (listing). Pasting grep:
```
grep -n "#batching" -R docs/ | sed -n '1,8p'
```
I'll open an issue for a sweep, unless we want to fold into this PR.

maya: Cool — let's keep this PR minimal (anchors only). Lisa please open the sweep issue and tag docs-squad. I'll rebase if needed.

docs-bot: link-checker: New scan complete — 5 broken anchors (priority: low). Report: https://ci.redwood/links/scan/2026-03-20/23

olivia: Thanks. @simon any blockers? If not, approve and I'll merge after CI passes.

simon: No blockers. Approved in PR comments. Will queue a quick re-run of CI.

ryan: Merged. Thx everyone. :sparkles:
